messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — PagerDuty alerts are delayed and a bunch are queuing. Seeing 4-7m delivery lag and some ack events not reflected in PD. PD status shows degraded delivery: https://status.pagerduty.com/incident/xyz (might change). No inference API errors, but oncall pages are delayed.

incidents-bot: New incident created — pd-webhook-delivery-delay. Impact: alert delivery delays. Severity: P2. Ticket: https://redwood.incidents/1815554321

Priya Kapoor: Confirming. Spike in webhook retries from pd-integration svc. Quick log snippet: 
```
2026-03-14T21:12:03Z pd-integration ERROR webhook POST https://events.pagerduty.com 504 retry=1
2026-03-14T21:15:37Z pd-integration WARN queued_messages=87 avg_delay_ms=350000
```

Marco Silva: Im oncall, taking lead. Plan: 1) disable batching on our PD integration, 2) add secondary fallback endpoint, 3) lower retry backoff. Priya can you run the runbook? @Jenna fyi for customer handoff.

Priya Kapoor: Runbook excerpt: 
- step 1: PD -> Services -> Integrations -> redwood-alerts -> Advanced -> batching = off
- step 2: Add secondary endpoint -> https://hooks.redwood-internal/ops-fallback
- step 3: Set retries to 2 with linear backoff
- step 4: Watch metric pd_integration.delivery.latency in Grafana
Doing step 1 now.

pd-integration-bot: Batching disabled for integration 'redwood-alerts' by Priya Kapoor.

Jenna Ortiz: Manually paging the phone tree for critical customers (Acct-A, Acct-B). Leaving voice call logs on the incident ticket.

Marco Silva: Updated escalation policy to include phone fallback and added temporary threshold increases to reduce noise. Notified support to prepare customer comms. Also opened a PD support ticket with request id PD-7890.

Priya Kapoor: After disabling batching delivery times dropped to ~30s for most alerts. Still seeing occasional 5xx from PD but queue length decreased. Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.internal/snap/abcd

Alex Chen: Customer impact summary so far: two customers experienced missed pages during the ~30m window (Acct-A, Acct-B). No customer-visible inference errors.

Marco Silva: Handoff: Priya will monitor for the next 30m. Ill be available if escalation required. Next steps: keep PD support ticket updated, gather delivery logs, and prepare postmortem. If delivery doesnt stabilize to <60s for 2h escalate to P1. @oncall-rotation-bot please record.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff recorded: Marco Silva -> Priya Kapoor at 2026-03-14T22:05:00Z

Priya Kapoor: Monitoring now. Will assemble timeline and postmortem draft tomorrow including root cause hypothesis (PD webhook batching/backlog), mitigation (disable batching + fallback endpoint), and suggested long-term change (add multi-provider alert routing). :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Incident pd-webhook-delivery-delay status updated to 'monitoring' by Priya Kapoor.

Alex Chen: Thanks all. Note: we've adjusted internal oncall playbooks to include immediate fallback if PD delivery latency exceeds 120s. Will capture metric export from PD and include in postmortem.
